limitations: Docker CPU samples are periodic observations, not proof that every non-container host process is idle.
Runner assignment uses the active issue window plus exact shared weight reference and actual full-session model log.
Resource sampling follows authenticated read requests; short service CPU bursts may include observer/read overhead.

resource_summary.scope: Periodic Docker samples; normal service/read overhead is included, and other host processes are not exhaustively observed.

comparison_note: Both fresh profiles executed real local tools with successful signed evidence. Candidate and control generated different token counts and used different runner batch sizes; whole-task latency improvement is a profile observation, not a pure thread-only estimate. Prose-contract limitations remain recorded by each benchmark harness.
